title: Event-Driven Language Models with Sparse Neural Activity for Neuromorphic Hardware
abstract: arXiv:2608.30439v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Inference with transformer-based large language models (LLMs) is often limited by the memory-bound KV cache and quadratic attention cost. State-space models (SSMs) mitigate this through linear attention and fixed-size recurrent states, but their large dense linear projections remain computationally expensive even after quantization. We introduce a method that induces sparse neural activity in heavily quantized linear-attention models with minimal performance loss. Activations below a per-projection trainable threshold ($\pm \Delta$) are nullified while preserving crucial outliers, achieving comparable performance to dense models with up to 4$\times$ fewer effective arithmetic operations. Targeting a multi-core, multi-chip neuromorphic platform, where event-driven execution converts unstructured sparsity into throughput at both the compute and communication levels, a capability GPU architectures fundamentally lack, we project up to 37$\

translated_title: 面向神经形态硬件的具有稀疏神经活动的事件驱动语言模型
translated_abstract: 基于Transformer的大语言模型（LLM）推理通常受限于内存瓶颈的KV缓存和二次方复杂度的注意力计算成本。状态空间模型（SSM）通过线性注意力和固定大小的循环状态缓解了这一问题，但其大规模稠密线性投影即使在量化之后仍然计算开销高昂。我们提出了一种方法，能够在深度量化的线性注意力模型中诱导稀疏神经活动，且几乎不损失性能。低于每个投影可训练阈值（±Δ）的激活值被置零，同时保留关键的离群值，从而在有效算术运算次数减少多达4倍的情况下，实现与稠密模型相当的性能。针对多核多芯片的神经形态平台——其中事件驱动的执行方式可以在计算和通信两个层面将非结构化稀疏性转化为吞吐量，这是GPU架构从根本上所缺乏的能力——我们预计最高可达37倍……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种在深度量化线性注意力模型中通过可训练阈值诱导稀疏神经活动的方法，将低于阈值的激活置零并保留关键离群值，在有效算术运算减少4倍的情况下保持性能，并借助神经形态硬件的事件驱动执行将非结构化稀疏性转化为高达37倍的吞吐量提升。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a method that induces sparse neural activity in heavily quantized linear-attention models via trainable per-projection thresholds, nullifying sub-threshold activations while preserving crucial outliers to achieve 4× fewer effective operations with minimal performance loss, and leverages event-driven execution on neuromorphic hardware to convert unstructured sparsity into projected throughput gains of up to 37×.
